No, not with that cart. Free Standard shipping applies to orders of **$75 or more after discounts (before tax)**. Your cart is $70 after the promo code, so Standard shipping would be **$7.95**.

- **Reaching free shipping:** adding $5 or more of items (after discounts) would bring you to $75 and make Standard shipping free.
- **Express:** it costs $14.95 and is never free.
- **Leafy Plus:** it's $59/year and includes free Standard shipping with no minimum. It also auto-renews, so it's probably only worth it if you expect to order often.

Extra fees, such as the $20 handling fee on XL plants, are separate from the shipping threshold. I can't say from the policy whether they count toward the $75, so I can escalate that to a Support Lead if it matters for your order.
